updated: The public, read-only data behind Spinback RCE - nothing here writes, and nothing here needs a key
rules: Read-only: no endpoint changes a Rust server, a setting or a Discord server.
No keys, no accounts, no tokens: everything listed here is public.
Anything the bot has not measured is null or absent, never guessed.
The bot's endpoints allow any origin (CORS: *). The site's own files are ordinary static files.

bot.what: The bot's own health: online, version, uptime seconds, guild count, gateway latency and the kind of storage its settings live in.
Whether the website-check shim is loaded, the window the full check gets, and the cheaper file it prefers.
The Discord servers the bot is in, as ids and names only.
The Rust servers the bot looks after, per server, with state and population. Written and reviewed, not published yet; the Servers page falls back to /api/status meanwhile.

site.what: Every command, subcommand and goal the bot registers, with who may run it and what it needs first.
The item catalogue Kit Studio uses: display name, short name, stack size, and where each entry came from.
The Rust Console Edition store as it was read on 11 November 2026: products, the skins inside them, release dates, gallery images and counts.
The cheapest true answer to whether this site is up.
The same list, written out for people.

never: RCON passwords - no endpoint returns one to anything running in a browser; a page may be told only whether one is set
the owner's Discord client secret and session secret
message content - the bot asks Discord for a single gateway intent, Guilds, so it cannot read messages
